metadata.name: agari_arena
metadata.description: Masayume's GameArena on Solana: a two-player duel over real Windows, each card one confirmed IOC pick, and only the side-pot the arena's to award

accounts.name: vault
docs: The pool's own money. Its authority is the season account, which only this program can sign for.

accounts.name: custody
docs: Every unit the arena holds: open pots, players' credits, keys' escrows.

accounts.name: agent
docs: The seat's key. It only signs: the stake and the refund are the player's.

accounts.name: game
docs: `init_if_needed` so a used id is refused as `MatchExists` and not as a system error.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless: a relayer or a friend can crank it without becoming the beneficiary.

accounts.name: player_token
docs: The player's own token account, and nobody else's (AD-5).

accounts.name: caller
docs: The player to revoke their own key at any time; anyone once the pick phase is over or the key has expired.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless: whoever holds the preimage may publish it, because the commitment, not a key, is what proves
the deck was fixed before either player saw it.

types.name: Agent
docs: A match-scoped delegate for one seat: the key the player named, until when, and the deck's own ceiling on the
stakes it may hand the arena (`per_card_cap × deck_size`, booked gross).
On the EVM the key's picks pull each stake from the player's wallet under a token allowance. An SPL token
account has one delegate, so a player in two matches would overwrite their own approval. Here the entry that
names a key escrows the ceiling beside the pot, the key's picks draw on it, and whatever is unspent becomes the
player's credit once the pick phase is over or the key is replaced.

fields.name: spent_base
docs: Gross: the stakes handed over, not the costs after refund, so the ceiling is the deck's and never a guess about fills.

fields.name: escrow_base
docs: What is still set aside for this key's picks.

types.name: AgentAuthorized
docs: `agent` is the default key for a revocation.

types.name: AgentReleased
docs: What a key never spent, back in its player's credit.

fields.name: chain_id
docs: The cluster id the deck commitment carries, fixed at init, so a deck committed for one cluster opens nothing on another.

fields.name: escrowed_base
docs: Pots held for undecided matches.

fields.name: credited_base
docs: Credits owed and unclaimed: payouts, pots won, pots refunded, a key's unspent escrow.

fields.name: agent_escrow_base
docs: Stakes players have set aside for their seats' keys.

fields.name: join_window_sec
docs: How long a created match waits for its challenger, a joined one for its deck, a revealed one for both players' picks.

fields.name: min_card_life_sec
docs: At reveal every card's Window must still have this long to run: a deck of Windows about to lock is a deck nobody can play.

types.name: Credit
docs: A player's claimable money. It pays the player, never whoever cranks the claim (AD-5).

types.name: GameMatch
docs: `creator` and `challenger` are the payout addresses too. They are never rewritten, so a compromised key cannot
redirect a pot (AD-5).

fields.name: picked_mask0
docs: One bit per card, per seat: set when that seat's pick is on the book.

fields.name: settled_mask
docs: One bit per card: set when both seats' picks on it have been redeemed.

fields.name: policy_version
docs: Bumped whenever the deck-selection rules change; part of the commitment preimage.

fields.name: picks
docs: Keyed `card_index × 2 + seat`, so one card's two picks sit beside each other.

fields.name: pnl_base
docs: `payout − cost` summed over settled cards, per seat.

fields.name: winner
docs: The default key for a tie.

types.name: MatchStatus
docs: WAITING until the challenger joins; ACTIVE_UNREVEALED until the deck is opened; PICKING while both players still
owe cards; then SETTLING (both complete), FORFEITED (one absent) or REFUNDED (nobody's fault). FINALIZED is the
pot's terminal state. Cards may settle in any of the last four, because a match that lost its pot still owns real
positions on the book. The order is `packages/core/src/games/types.ts`'s `ARENA_STATUSES`.

fields.name: quantity_raw
docs: Contracts, in raw units (`lots × lot_base`).

types.name: PickRecord
docs: What the engine reported around one IOC, and what the redemption later paid for it. Never the quote a player was shown.

fields.name: forfeited_by
docs: The seat that never finished; the default key when both did.

types.name: RefundReason
docs: Why a pot went home instead of being won. The order is core's `ARENA_REFUND_REASONS`.

types.name: SeasonPool
docs: A season's prize, as money that already sits in an account and not a promise on a page. Standings and
eligibility live off chain (the ladder the settler writes); this is only the payout rail. Funds leave through one
single-shot distribution or the admin's withdrawal of what is left, so the pool can be neither replayed nor
over-spent, and nothing is ever stuck. `ends_at_sec` is informational.

fields.name: distributed
docs: Set once `admin_distribute_season` runs; blocks a second distribution.

fields.name: deposited_base
docs: Everything ever deposited, so a page can say how the pool was built and not only what is left.

types.name: Tier
docs: One entry price. `pot_base` is what each player escrows; `per_card_cap_base` is the most one card's order may
spend. Free is a tier with a zero pot: its picks are still real orders.
